title: Guest settings
description: Manage the guest switch, model whitelist, budgets, quotas, rate limit, concurrency and token limits. Changes apply to new requests immediately.

fields.enabledHint: When off, the login-page entry and guest APIs close together; in-flight generations still settle normally.
fields.modelWhitelistHint: Comma-separated platform model names. Empty means no models are exposed.
fields.rateLimitHint: Default 20. Increase it for a looser limit.
fields.budgetTimezoneHint: IANA name such as Europe/Berlin; quotas reset on that timezone's calendar day.
fields.modelWhitelistEmpty: No active platform models yet; create one on the Models page first.
fields.modelWhitelistUnknown: These names are not in the platform model list and will have no effect: {names}

saved: Saved; new requests pick it up immediately
guestUsageHint: Sorted by settled amount; only anonymous public ids are shown.
billsHint: Contains only model, status, amounts and the billing reference; never conversation content.
noContentNote: This list neither stores nor displays any conversation content.
